correctness.rationale: Two positional deletions of a finite sequence agree iff the intervening entries form a constant run; the deletion count is 1 plus adjacent changes. Adjacent ell-window Parikh vectors agree iff exiting and entering symbols agree. Thus B_ell=1+sum_(i<=n-ell)1{X_i != X_(i+ell)}. Each fixed-lag graph is a union of paths, so equalities form independent Bernoulli variables by exposing forest roots and fresh child labels. Any cycle violates independence because all edge equalities have probability q^(1-r) rather than q^(-r). Edges from two distinct lags are different and form a two-edge forest, proving zero covariance, while n=3 binary dependence rules out full independence. Independently exhausted q=2,n=5 and q=3,n=4 read sequences, descendant sets, binomial masses, cross-scale covariance. This does not prove the infinite theorem by enumeration.
